# OpenProgram 0.9.1 Release Notes

This release includes the completed repository organization and storage reliability changes, together with all fixes published in 0.9.0.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Organize checkpoint storage by filesystem capture, planning, transaction execution, document receipts and mutation journal responsibilities while preserving public imports.
- Group storage tests and Web center-tab components by feature; move tab styles next to their owning components.
- Preserve durable session metadata, HEAD ordering, creation placement and deletion recovery across failures and retries.
- Validate recovery receipts before execution, preserve unreadable records, and close filesystem descriptors on interrupted operations.
- Preserve mutation ordering when an existing sequence counter cannot be read or contains invalid data.
- Retain the portable snapshot and Windows migration fixes from 0.9.0.

The broader repository audit is ongoing. This release includes completed, reviewed changes and does not claim that every source file has been audited.

## ✨ New features

No additional product feature is introduced in this maintenance release. Durable function continuation from 0.9.0 remains available.

## 🚀 Improvements

Feature-owned modules and styles make the completed storage and center-tab changes easier to maintain while retaining compatibility entry points.

## 📦 Download and installation

- **macOS**
  - **Package installation**
    - Apple Silicon: download `OpenProgram-0.9.1-mac-arm64-unsigned.dmg` or `OpenProgram-0.9.1-mac-arm64-unsigned.zip`.
    - Intel: download `OpenProgram-0.9.1-mac-x64-unsigned.dmg` or `OpenProgram-0.9.1-mac-x64-unsigned.zip`.
  - **Command-line installation**
    - Run `curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | sh`.
  - **Development installation**
    - Follow the development installation guide for source editing and testing.
  - macOS package and command-line installations share the same complete runtime and browser backend. Electron multi-Pane support and the built-in Browser Pane are available only in the macOS Desktop App.
- **Linux**
  - **Command-line / Server installation**
    - Run `curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | sh`.
  - **Development installation**
    - Follow the development installation guide for source editing and testing.

## 🔄 Upgrade guide

- Desktop users can install the matching DMG and replace the existing application.
- CLI and Server users can run `openprogram upgrade` or repeat the public installation command.
- User data under `~/.openprogram` is preserved.

The release also includes Python wheel and source-distribution artifacts, complete managed runtimes for supported macOS and Linux architectures, checksums, and a machine-readable release manifest.
